decisions.reason: Early customer feedback praising the nearly 200 agency templates suggests the product meets its aspiration in a clear niche, so there is no shortfall to trigger problemistic search and the low marginal cost of software lets the firm carry it.

Featured on the home page, the hosting management platform appears central to the firm's core business and strategic identity, making a drop within a year unlikely even though results are still uncertain.

The configurable managed hosting plan complements the core hosting platform and uses existing infrastructure, so there is little pressure to reallocate its modest resources despite the lack of performance evidence.
